name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Experimental surface tram terminus. Native reversal is not yet proven; test saves only.
description: Private prototype revision 4 adds a separate two-track surface terminus with a scissors crossover and a native electric tramtrack entrance. Original prototype constructions remain unchanged. Select UM Crossover Terminus (Test). Native reversal, path connectivity, passenger access and crossing reservations require in-game testing with one vehicle. Internal rail and catenary visuals are unfinished. No hidden turning loop or automatic vehicle commands. Use a separate test save. Do not remove while constructions remain. Read-only diagnostics inspect both prototypes. Uses Urban Games station assets and infrastructure.
